intent: Separate responder display and retrospective dossier inset with a hard gutter. The reader may see both, but no sightline or overlay should give the responder the inset's later knowledge.
source:

**Caption:**
> THE ALERT DOES NOT ARRIVE AS THE WHOLE STORY.

title: Unseen compromise stays outside responder knowledge
